title: Metering event catalogue: what Papyrus reports to Prospectus, when, and in which unit
description:
Outcome: One reviewed list, in code and docs, of every metering event, using Prospectus's namespaced item kinds (docs/QUOTA.md, docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md). Model calls, reported per call batch with the Account and the deployment (site): openai.tokens.input / .cached / .output per model, jev.tokens, image generation per image and model, web search calls. Work Papyrus runs: aws.lambda.gb_seconds for content-actions and the other functions (measured per invocation, attributed to the tenant in the TenantContext), aws.batch.vcpu_seconds for cloud knowledge and Cyclotron runs (reserve, then settle), aws.appsync.requests (request meter, per tenant), aws.dynamodb.write_units and read_units (estimated from the request meter), aws.s3.put_requests per projection, aws.cloudfront.invalidation_paths per purge, aws.ses.emails per newsletter recipient. Daily: aws.s3.storage_gb_days per tenant prefix (S3 Inventory), aws.cloudfront.requests and bytes per host (logs or per-tenant metrics). Each event carries an operation id so a retry never double counts. Shared resources are tagged anthus:account=shared and split by these reported usages (Prospectus cost accounting).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new src/papyrus_content/metering.py (catalogue + batching client for the quota routes), lib/metering.ts twin, src/papyrus_content/request_meter.py (tenant dimension), src/papyrus_content/model_cost.py (prices stay a local estimate; Prospectus prices for billing), docs/metering.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/metering-events.feature):
Scenario: A model call is reported once to the tenant's Account
    Given an "alpha" editor runs an editorial check that makes two model calls
    When the batch is sent and then retried
    Then Prospectus records the token items once, for alpha's Account and deployment "alpha"

Scenario: An unknown item kind is noticed, not free
    Given Papyrus sends an item kind Prospectus does not know
    When the usage call returns 422 unknown_item_kind
    Then Papyrus logs an operator alert and the work is not marked free

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-6d9a6d, PPY-9f929e. Blocks PPY-889ab5, PPY-49d059. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-ea3f08.

Testing: Unit tests of batching and retry; a fake quota server in Behave (no network in specs).
Rollout: Report-only first (dry run to a log), then live once Prospectus has the kinds in its rate table.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: metering adds latency to requests. Mitigation: batched off the request path (Prospectus 'never slow an app down' rule); flushed at invocation end.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).

comments.text: Transport changed: Papyrus sends usage through the Prospectus cost-accounting SQS queue via the shared sender library (PPY-25e0d7, now a blocker), using app=papyrus, deployment=site id and namespaced token kinds without dollars. The quota check stays the pre-flight gate in PPY-889ab5 once quota is live for Papyrus.
